components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #0f172a; margin: 0 0 4px 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 12px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0 0 12px 0; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9; padding-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-tags { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; background: #eef2ff; color: #4338ca; border: 1px solid #c7d2fe; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-priority-badge { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-priority-high { color: #e11d48; }

narrative.overview: Next Play Games - Kanban uses a warm, high-clarity light theme engineered for daytime production sprints and multi-view project execution. It marries a warm alabaster canvas (#f8fafc) with crisp white card surfaces (#ffffff), subtle cool slate structural dividers (#e2e8f0), and vibrant indigo accents (#6366f1).
keyCharacteristics: Warm Alabaster Canvas: Soft #f8fafc backdrop prevents harsh glare while providing crisp optical contrast against pure white cards.
Pure White Cards with Subtle Depth: Cards stand out via hairline #e2e8f0 borders and soft ambient elevation (shadow-sm transitioning to shadow-md on hover).
Vibrant Indigo Signature: Electric Indigo (#6366f1) drives primary actions, active navigation states, and focus rings.
Status-Coded Top Accent Borders: Kanban columns feature 2px status headers (Slate, Indigo, Amber, Emerald) for instant peripheral orientation.

rules.name: The Clean Container Rule
rules.body: Column pods and scroll containers use clean background colors (#ffffff / #f8fafc) without backdrop-blur filters or transform properties, ensuring drag-and-drop coordinate math stays locked to the pointer.

rules.name: The Telemetry Luminescence Rule
rules.body: High-chroma colors (#6366f1, #059669, #d97706, #e11d48) are reserved for operational telemetry (status borders, tag chips, priority badges) and never applied as solid backgrounds across full cards.

rules.name: The Micro-Metadata Rule
rules.body: Card priority badges and taxonomy tags are set in compact uppercase tracking (10px, bold, 0.05em) to maximize scanability without competing with task titles.

dos: Do maintain high text contrast on light surfaces (Slate 900 for titles, Slate 600 for body).
Do keep ancestor wrappers of DragDropContext free from backdrop-blur-* and transform properties.
Do preserve 2px status top accent borders on Kanban columns.
Do use uppercase 10px tracking for priority flags and taxonomy labels.
donts: Don't add backdrop-blur filters to the main content container or Kanban column wrappers.
Don't use low-contrast grey-on-white text that fails accessibility guidelines.
Don't apply heavy dark shadow rings on resting cards; keep shadows soft and clean.
